title: Graflume ChartSpec
description: Portable, versioned chart specification for Graflume 0.1.

duration.description: Requested maximum duration in milliseconds; runtime clamps it below the playback interval.

type.description: Built-in marks are listed in x-graflume-catalog; registered plugin mark names remain valid strings.

stack.description: Function-free one-layer series layout for Area, Bar, and Theme river. A series field is required in mark.fields.series.

kind.description: Technical-indicator registry kind. Calculation support is exposed by technicalIndicatorCapabilities.

calculate.description: Materialize the selected registry indicator before domain resolution. All built-in named presets are computed; omit this flag to render supplied columns.

session.description: Portable technical-indicator session boundary and state-reset policy.
